text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text: There, that's twenty down. Pretty impressive, actually.
text_block_list.orig_text:
うん、
これで20勝……
意外とすごいじゃん。

text_block_list.name: Rin
text_block_list.text:
But the enemy's still ready to fight.
I'll protect your back, so let's stay focused to the end.
text_block_list.orig_text:
けど、
相手はまだやる気みたいだよ。
背中は私が守るから、
最後まで気を抜かずに戦おう。
